items.t: JP Morgan Maintains Overweight on Itau Unibanco Holding, Lowers Price Target to $9
items.sum: JP Morgan analyst Domingos Falavina maintains Itau Unibanco Holding (NYSE:ITUB) with a Overweight and lowers the price target from $10 to $9.

items.t: NU Holdings Builds Its Deposit Base: Can Funding Costs Decline?
items.sum: NU is set to grow deposits across Latin America while lowering funding costs. Can its expanding deposit franchise support lending growth and improve funding efficiency?

items.t: ICICI Bank Hits a 52-Week High: Can Growth Drivers Sustain the Rally?
items.sum: IBN hits a 52-week high as digital expansion, domestic loan growth and rising fee income aid its earnings growth, despite asset quality and valuation concerns.
